description: The A/B experiment a widget is in (or last ran as control): per arm, assigned views, leads, conversion rate and 95% interval in basis points (1234 = 12.34%), and lift against the control arm. result "insufficient_data" means at least one arm has too few views for a rate to mean anything; in that case NO rate or lift is given for any arm, so none is available. A running experiment lists every arm, including one with no views yet. The "holdout" arm sees no widget, so it shows exposure only. beatsControlBp is the chance (in basis points) that a variant beats the control. verdict.status is collecting, leaning or winner, with a leader arm and a plain-language note; it informs a decision and never stops or publishes anything. Views are page loads, so repeat visitors count more than once and the odds are directional.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.
